problem_hypothesis: Multi-category booking requests may require repetitive manual checking for service type, urgency, city or area, preferred time, and missing contact details.
solution: A booking-triage assistant that validates required fields, classifies the service and urgency, calculates a priority score, and prepares a draft response for human review.
expected_value: Faster and more consistent first-pass booking review while keeping availability, pricing, and final customer communication under human control.
limitations: hypothesis requires validation with the business
no pricing or professional assignment automation
